prompts.title: Summarize with takeaways
prompts.description: Turn any long text into a tight summary plus the points worth acting on.
prompts.template:
Summarize the text below for {{audience}}.

Format: {{format}}.
Then list the 3 most important takeaways and any decision or action the reader should take.
Don't add facts that aren't in the text. If something is unclear, say so.

Text:
"""
{{text}}
"""

fields.label: Format
fields.description: How long should the summary be?

prompts.title: Rewrite in a different tone
prompts.description: Keep the meaning, change the voice.
prompts.template:
Rewrite the text below in a {{tone}} tone.
Keep the meaning and every fact the same. Keep it about the same length.
{{constraints}}

Text:
"""
{{text}}
"""

fields.label: Extra rules
fields.description: Anything to avoid or include, like banned words or a word limit.
fields.placeholder: e.g. No exclamation marks. Under 120 words.

prompts.title: Cold email to a new prospect
prompts.description: A short, specific first-touch email that leads with their problem, not your product.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Name, and a few words on what they do.

fields.label: Their pain point
fields.description: What are they struggling with that you can help with?

fields.label: Next step
options: A reply with a quick yes/no
An intro to the right person

prompts.title: Meeting notes to action items
prompts.description: Clean up messy notes into decisions, owners, and deadlines.
prompts.template:
Turn these meeting notes into a clear recap.

Sections, in this order:
1. Decisions made
2. Action items (owner, task, due date)
3. Open questions
4. One-sentence summary for people who weren't there

If an owner or date isn't stated, write "unassigned" or "no date" rather than guessing.
{{people}}

Notes:
"""
{{notes}}
"""

fields.label: Attendees
fields.description: List the names so owners are spelled correctly.

fields.label: Raw notes
fields.description: Paste them exactly as you have them.

prompts.title: Explain it to a newcomer
prompts.description: Get a clear explanation pitched at your level.
prompts.template:
Explain {{topic}} to someone who is: {{level}}.

Use {{style}}. Define any jargon the first time it appears.
End with 3 questions I could answer to check I actually understood it.

fields.label: Topic
fields.description: What do you want to understand?

prompts.title: Code review
prompts.description: A focused review that ranks issues instead of listing everything.

fields.label: Context
fields.description: What does the code need to do? Any constraints?

prompts.title: Improve my prompt
prompts.description: Ask for a sharper version of a prompt, with the reasoning.

fields.label: Current prompt
fields.description: Paste the prompt as it is now.

fields.label: Goal
fields.description: What should a good answer look like?
